get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying which properties to include via the `properties` query parameter. This endpoint is useful for retrieving a list of objects with specific attributes for further processing or analysis.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and the value is the property's value. All properties are strings.

schema.description: Represents the input required to update a CRM object, containing an object with property names and their corresponding values.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether the object is archived.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when this object was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this object, represented as a string.

objectWriteTraceId.description: An identifier used to trace the creation or update request of the CRM object.

properties.description: A map of property names to their values, where each value is a string.

sourceId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the source from which the value was obtained.

sourceLabel.description: A string label providing additional context or description of the source.

sourceType.description: A string indicating the type of source from which the value was obtained.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who last updated the value, represented as an integer.

value.description: The actual value being tracked, represented as a string.

items.description: Property model that includes timestamp.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to arrays of their historical values, each entry containing a value and its timestamp.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string representing the URL of the object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to the object, each containing a category, message, and context.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the warning.

context.description: An object providing additional context about the warning, with string values for each context key.

message.description: A string containing the warning message.

items.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specific object identified by its type and ID. The results are limited to 500 associations per call, making it useful for managing and understanding the relationships between different CRM objects.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the associated object.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token representing the cursor position for fetching the next page of results.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an associated object with its labels. Each item in the array is a MultiAssociatedObjectWithLabel.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each including a label, that defines the types of associations between this object and the target object. Each item in the array is an AssociationSpecWithLabel object.

category.description: The category of the association, indicating its origin or purpose. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the type ID of the object from which the association originates.

label.description: A string representing the label of the association, providing a human-readable name or description.

toObjectTypeId.description: A string representing the type ID of the object to which the association is directed.

typeId.description: An integer that uniquely identifies the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the target object to which this object is associated. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
